[!GOOS:linux] skip 'native level oracle reads /proc/cpuinfo'
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'native level oracle needs linux/amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOAMD64=
env GOARM64=

logos build -o $WORK/native$GOEXE .
exec go run ./cpulevel $WORK/native$GOEXE
stdout 'native level match'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/nativelvl

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[build]
target_cpu = "native"

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}

-- cpulevel/main.go --
package main

import (
	"debug/buildinfo"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func has(set map[string]bool, name string) bool {
	if name == "sse3" {
		return set["sse3"] || set["pni"]
	}
	return set[name]
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: cpulevel <binary>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile("/proc/cpuinfo")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read cpuinfo:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	set := map[string]bool{}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "flags") {
			continue
		}
		parts := strings.SplitN(line, ":", 2)
		if len(parts) != 2 {
			continue
		}
		for _, f := range strings.Fields(parts[1]) {
			set[f] = true
		}
		break
	}
	v2 := has(set, "cx16") && has(set, "lahf_lm") && has(set, "popcnt") && has(set, "sse3") && has(set, "sse4_1") && has(set, "sse4_2") && has(set, "ssse3")
	v3 := has(set, "avx") && has(set, "avx2") && has(set, "bmi1") && has(set, "bmi2") && has(set, "f16c") && has(set, "fma") && (has(set, "abm") || has(set, "lzcnt")) && has(set, "movbe") && has(set, "xsave")
	v4 := has(set, "avx512f") && has(set, "avx512bw") && has(set, "avx512cd") && has(set, "avx512dq") && has(set, "avx512vl")
	want := "v1"
	if v2 {
		want = "v2"
	}
	if v3 {
		want = "v3"
	}
	if v4 {
		want = "v4"
	}
	bi, err := buildinfo.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read buildinfo:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	got := ""
	for _, s := range bi.Settings {
		if s.Key == "GOAMD64" {
			got = s.Value
		}
	}
	if got == "" {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "GOAMD64 missing from build settings")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if got != want {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "native level mismatch: cpuinfo wants %s binary has %s\n", want, got)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Printf("native level match GOAMD64=%s cpuinfo=%s\n", got, want)
}
